description: This is a PHP source file defining an abstract class InstallerCommand in the OrangeHRM project. The class extends a Console Command and overrides the run method to include installation checks and error logging.

classes.name: InstallerCommand
classes.description: An abstract class extending Command, providing a run method that checks if the system is already installed, logs errors, and invokes the parent run method.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Overrides the parent run method to perform installation check, log errors if exceptions occur, and set up IO streams.
